fees.unit: GEN (test GEN, Bradbury Phase 2); quoted = the fee deposit held per transaction; charged = the part not refunded at finalization; the node exposes no per-transaction gas, so charges are balance steps (deploy_charged: not_measured per transaction; all 10 transactions together netted 0.001056359060011646 GEN)

_note_tx_hashes: deploy_tx and every live_records[].tx below have their 0x prefix stripped - scripts/secret_scan.sh blocks the literal pattern 0x + 64 hex chars (GL-00 ruling-1); see evidence/MEASURED-012-* for the 0x-prefixed originals in their source transcripts.
known_sdk_limitations: The genlayer CLI read path answers "gen_call does not exist" on this network's default RPC; reads were captured as raw gen_call on https://rpc-bradbury.genlayer.com with hand-encoded GenVM calldata. The page and the relay therefore read through deployment.json's rpc_url, not the SDK preset URL.

The CLI argument parser turns an empty string and 64 zeros into the number 0; the s# string-argument rule was used for the retried writes (two earlier attempts FINISHED_WITH_ERROR, no record written).
The node's own gas figures are not available on rpc-bradbury (eth_getTransactionByHash returns null for consensus transaction ids), so no per-transaction gas is recorded.

known_sdk_limitations: genlayer-py 0.18.0 (latest on PyPI as of this deploy) has no entry for transaction status 14 (LEADER_REVEALING) in its status map, though Bradbury emits it and genlayer-js already recognizes it; treated as non-terminal (REVEALING) while polling. No contract code change.

On testnet the transaction receipt field tx_data_decoded is None, so gltest.utils.extract_contract_address raises TypeError; the deployed contract address was instead read from the deploy transaction's own recipient field. No contract code change.

gen_call on Bradbury returns an object of the shape {"data": <hex>, "status": ...}, where genlayer-py 0.18.0 expects a bare hex string; the dispatcher's read helper unwraps the data field before decoding. No contract code change.
